name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.336.0 — The legs seal the manifest: one shared manifest reader (lib/manifest.js) keeps the first row per leg and reports a duplicate leg as invalid evidence; the review driver records a digest of each manifest its legs run wrote and refuses every later invocation on drift, naming the cause and the rm-and-rerun remedy; the reviewer and disposer re-run a leg only against a scratch copy. 7.335.0 — One suite run per tree: a run cache keyed by the content tree lets the build, fan-out and review drivers reuse a green gate or suite for an unchanged tree; the gate resolves {testFiles} to the File Plan's exact test files; policy.closeSuite (auto|always) skips the close-time whole-suite run when the close delta is overlay-only and no test reads it; /spec:fix workers run only their named test file and the session runs the gate once. 7.334.0 — the queue seeds ad-hoc specs alongside briefs, and release --briefs accepts lettered NNa brief ids.
